_doc: Single source of truth for the in-app 'What's new' banner (#43). `entries` maps an EXACT desktop-shell semantic version to the banner it shows the first time a user runs that version (or newer). `actionKind` is a TYPED, bounded key the banner routes (see 04e_whatsnew.jsx `_ACTION_LABELS`); null = an informational banner with no action. `no_banner` records versions that deliberately ship without a banner (a bug-fix release), so the release drift gate (tools/check_whatsnew_coverage.py) passes on explicit silence rather than an accidental omission. build_frontend injects only `entries` into the page as window.CALLOSUM_WHATSNEW; the gate reads this whole file.

0.5.5.headline: New: Local AI — run Callosum's compatible AI features on this device, no API key or cloud account required.

0.5.13.headline: New literature Feed sources: follow arXiv, Europe PMC, and PsyArXiv alongside bioRxiv, medRxiv, PubMed, and journals — in Discover → Feed.

0.5.14.headline: Stay with the paper: while reading a PDF, ask a question about it, look up a cited reference, and add, acquire & critique that citation — all without leaving the reader.

0.5.12.note: Bug-fix release (external links now open in the system browser); the what's-new mechanism did not exist when it shipped.
